notes: from is Caldas de Reis (end of stage 9). Xunta de Galicia stage Caldas de Reis to Padrón, with Carracedo and San Miguel de Valga on the way. Carracedo: civil parish relation (Caldas de Reis), 0.40 km from the route. As Cernadas: hamlet node (Valga) added to hold the line between Carracedo and Valga, 0.25 km from the route. San Miguel de Valga: hamlet node whose OSM name is 'San Miguel' (Valga), 0.02 km from the route; the Xunta calls the place San Miguel de Valga. Pontecesures: the municipality relation (place=municipality), 0.39 km from the route; the Camino crosses the Ulla there (from memory). Padrón: place=town node from Photon. Not coastal: OSM API map calls around the Pontecesures bridge and 3.7 km west of it (the Ulla estuary) find no natural=coastline. Checked against OSM relation 12786090 (Caminho Português de Santiago, ref CP), read through the OSM API on 2026-11-07: the 18.9 km between the two ends stay within 0.71 km of the straight lines through these points. Published figures seen, not copied into distance_km: Rother 18.5 km, Vagamundos 18.5 km.
